Hands-on experience configuring or supporting firewalls, VPNs, virtual desktop technologies, servers, cloud services, endpoint platforms, and remote-management tools. Demonstrated ability to follow technical designs and implementation standards, execute deployment checklists, test completed work, and maintain accurate documentation. Experience collaborating with remote MSPs or outsourced service providers, including ticket management, troubleshooting coordination, escalation, follow-through, and validation of completed work. Strong customer service, troubleshooting, documentation, organization, and communication skills. Preferred: Experience supporting healthcare delivery organizations, physician practices, ambulatory clinics, or other regulated environments. Familiarity with healthcare applications, medical devices, imaging workflows, secure interfaces, and data exchange between clinical systems. Working knowledge of HIPAA-aligned security practices, risk management, least-privilege access, auditability, and protection of sensitive health information. Experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, virtualization platforms, and common enterprise networking and security technologies. Remote MSPs and vendors receive clear information, remain accountable for assigned work, and complete changes that are tested and validated.
